ayahs.tr: Ha, Meem.
'Ayn, Seen, Qaf.

ayahs.ar: كَذٰلِكَ يُوْحِيْٓ اِلَيْكَ وَاِلَي الَّذِيْنَ مِنْ قَبْلِكَۙ اللّٰهُ الْعَزِيْزُ الْحَكِيْمُ ۝٣
ayahs.tr: Thus has He revealed to you, [O Muhammad], and to those before you - Allah, the Exalted in Might, the Wise.

ayahs.ar: لَهٗ مَا فِي السَّمٰوٰتِ وَمَا فِي الْاَرْضِؕ وَهُوَ الْعَلِيُّ الْعَظِيْمُ ۝٤
ayahs.tr: To Him belongs whatever is in the heavens and whatever is in the earth, and He is the Most High, the Most Great.

ayahs.ar: تَكَادُ السَّمٰوٰتُ يَتَفَطَّرْنَ مِنْ فَوْقِهِنَّ وَالْمَلٰ࢜ىِٕكَةُ يُسَبِّحُوْنَ بِحَمْدِ رَبِّهِمْ وَيَسْتَغْفِرُوْنَ لِمَنْ فِي الْاَرْضِؕ اَلَا͏ٓ اِنَّ اللّٰهَ هُوَ الْغَفُوْرُ الرَّحِيْمُ ۝٥
ayahs.tr: The heavens almost break from above them, and the angels exalt [Allah] with praise of their Lord and ask forgiveness for those on earth. Unquestionably, it is Allah who is the Forgiving, the Merciful.

ayahs.ar: وَالَّذِيْنَ اتَّخَذُوْا مِنْ دُوْنِهٖٓ اَوْلِيَا࢜ءَ اللّٰهُ حَفِيْظٌ عَلَيْهِمْؗۖ وَمَا͏ٓ اَنْتَ عَلَيْهِمْ بِوَكِيْلٍ ۝٦
ayahs.tr: And those who take as allies other than Him - Allah is [yet] Guardian over them; and you, [O Muhammad], are not over them a manager.

ayahs.ar: وَكَذٰلِكَ اَوْحَيْنَا͏ٓ اِلَيْكَ قُرْاٰنًا عَرَبِيًّا لِّتُنْذِرَ اُمَّ الْقُرٰي وَمَنْ حَوْلَهَا وَتُنْذِرَ يَوْمَ الْجَمْعِ لَا رَيْبَ فِيْهِؕ فَرِيْقٌ فِي الْجَنَّةِ وَفَرِيْقٌ فِي السَّعِيْرِ ۝٧
ayahs.tr: And thus We have revealed to you an Arabic Qur'an that you may warn the Mother of Cities [Makkah] and those around it and warn of the Day of Assembly, about which there is no doubt. A party will be in Paradise and a party in the Blaze.

ayahs.ar: وَلَوْ شَا࢜ءَ اللّٰهُ لَجَعَلَهُمْ اُمَّةً وَّاحِدَةً وَّلٰكِنْ يُّدْخِلُ مَنْ يَّشَا࢜ءُ فِيْ رَحْمَتِهٖؕ وَالظّٰلِمُوْنَ مَا لَهُمْ مِّنْ وَّلِيٍّ وَّلَا نَصِيْرٍ ۝٨
ayahs.tr: And if Allah willed, He could have made them [of] one religion, but He admits whom He wills into His mercy. And the wrongdoers have not any protector or helper.

ayahs.ar: اَمِ اتَّخَذُوْا مِنْ دُوْنِهٖٓ اَوْلِيَا࢜ءَۚ فَاللّٰهُ هُوَ الْوَلِيُّ وَهُوَ يُحْيِ الْمَوْتٰيؗ وَهُوَ عَلٰي كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيْرٌ ۝٩ࣖ
ayahs.tr: Or have they taken protectors [or allies] besides him? But Allah - He is the Protector, and He gives life to the dead, and He is over all things competent.

ayahs.ar: وَمَا اخْتَلَفْتُمْ فِيْهِ مِنْ شَيْءٍ فَحُكْمُهٗٓ اِلَي اللّٰهِؕ ذٰلِكُمُ اللّٰهُ رَبِّيْ عَلَيْهِ تَوَكَّلْتُࣗۖ وَاِلَيْهِ اُنِيْبُ ۝١٠
ayahs.tr: And in anything over which you disagree - its ruling is [to be referred] to Allah. [Say], "That is Allah, my Lord; upon Him I have relied, and to Him I turn back."

ayahs.ar: فَاطِرُ السَّمٰوٰتِ وَالْاَرْضِؕ جَعَلَ لَكُمْ مِّنْ اَنْفُسِكُمْ اَزْوَاجًا وَّمِنَ الْاَنْعَامِ اَزْوَاجًاۚ يَذْرَو͏ٔ͏ُكُمْ فِيْهِؕ لَيْسَ كَمِثْلِهٖ شَيْءٌۚ وَهُوَ السَّمِيْعُ الْبَصِيْرُ ۝١١
ayahs.tr: [He is] Creator of the heavens and the earth. He has made for you from yourselves, mates, and among the cattle, mates; He multiplies you thereby. There is nothing like unto Him, and He is the Hearing, the Seeing.

ayahs.ar: لَهٗ مَقَالِيْدُ السَّمٰوٰتِ وَالْاَرْضِۚ يَبْسُطُ الرِّزْقَ لِمَنْ يَّشَا࢜ءُ وَيَقْدِرُؕ اِنَّهٗ بِكُلِّ شَيْءٍ عَلِيْمٌ ۝١٢
ayahs.tr: To Him belong the keys of the heavens and the earth. He extends provision for whom He wills and restricts [it]. Indeed He is, of all things, Knowing.

ayahs.ar: شَرَعَ لَكُمْ مِّنَ الدِّيْنِ مَا وَصّٰي بِهٖ نُوْحًا وَّالَّذِيْٓ اَوْحَيْنَا͏ٓ اِلَيْكَ وَمَا وَصَّيْنَا بِهٖٓ اِبْرٰهِيْمَ وَمُوْسٰي وَعِيْسٰٓي اَنْ اَقِيْمُوا الدِّيْنَ وَلَا تَتَفَرَّقُوْا فِيْهِؕ كَبُرَ عَلَي الْمُشْرِكِيْنَ مَا تَدْعُوْهُمْ اِلَيْهِؕ اَللّٰهُ يَجْتَبِيْٓ اِلَيْهِ مَنْ يَّشَا࢜ءُ وَيَهْدِيْٓ اِلَيْهِ مَنْ يُّنِيْبُ ۝١٣
ayahs.tr: He has ordained for you of religion what He enjoined upon Noah and that which We have revealed to you, [O Muhammad], and what We enjoined upon Abraham and Moses and Jesus - to establish the religion and not be divided therein. Difficult for those who associate others with Allah is that to which you invite them. Allah chooses for Himself whom He wills and guides to Himself whoever turns back [to Him].

ayahs.ar: وَمَا تَفَرَّقُوْٓا اِلَّا مِنْۢ بَعْدِ مَا جَا࢜ءَهُمُ الْعِلْمُ بَغْيًاۢ بَيْنَهُمْؕ وَلَوْلَا كَلِمَةٌ سَبَقَتْ مِنْ رَّبِّكَ اِلٰٓي اَجَلٍ مُّسَمًّي لَّقُضِيَ بَيْنَهُمْؕ وَاِنَّ الَّذِيْنَ اُوْرِثُوا الْكِتٰبَ مِنْۢ بَعْدِهِمْ لَفِيْ شَكٍّ مِّنْهُ مُرِيْبٍ ۝١٤
ayahs.tr: And they did not become divided until after knowledge had come to them - out of jealous animosity between themselves. And if not for a word that preceded from your Lord [postponing the penalty] until a specified time, it would have been concluded between them. And indeed, those who were granted inheritance of the Scripture after them are, concerning it, in disquieting doubt.

ayahs.ar: فَلِذٰلِكَ فَادْعُۚ وَاسْتَقِمْ كَمَا͏ٓ اُمِرْتَۚ وَلَا تَتَّبِعْ اَهْوَا࢜ءَهُمْۚ وَقُلْ اٰمَنْتُ بِمَا͏ٓ اَنْزَلَ اللّٰهُ مِنْ كِتٰبٍۚ وَاُمِرْتُ لِاَعْدِلَ بَيْنَكُمْؕ اَللّٰهُ رَبُّنَا وَرَبُّكُمْؕ لَنَا͏ٓ اَعْمَالُنَا وَلَكُمْ اَعْمَالُكُمْؕ لَا حُجَّةَ بَيْنَنَا وَبَيْنَكُمْؕ اَللّٰهُ يَجْمَعُ بَيْنَنَاۚ وَاِلَيْهِ الْمَصِيْرُ ۝١٥ؕ
ayahs.tr: So to that [religion of Allah] invite, [O Muhammad], and remain on a right course as you are commanded and do not follow their inclinations but say, "I have believed in what Allah has revealed of the Qur'an, and I have been commanded to do justice among you. Allah is our Lord and your Lord. For us are our deeds, and for you your deeds. There is no [need for] argument between us and you. Allah will bring us together, and to Him is the [final] destination."

ayahs.ar: وَالَّذِيْنَ يُحَا࢜جُّوْنَ فِي اللّٰهِ مِنْۢ بَعْدِ مَا اسْتُجِيْبَ لَهٗ حُجَّتُهُمْ دَاحِضَةٌ عِنْدَ رَبِّهِمْ وَعَلَيْهِمْ غَضَبٌ وَّلَهُمْ عَذَابٌ شَدِيْدٌ ۝١٦
ayahs.tr: And those who argue concerning Allah after He has been responded to - their argument is invalid with their Lord, and upon them is [His] wrath, and for them is a severe punishment.

ayahs.ar: اَللّٰهُ الَّذِيْٓ اَنْزَلَ الْكِتٰبَ بِالْحَقِّ وَالْمِيْزَانَؕ وَمَا يُدْرِيْكَ لَعَلَّ السَّاعَةَ قَرِيْبٌ ۝١٧
ayahs.tr: It is Allah who has sent down the Book in truth and [also] the balance. And what will make you perceive? Perhaps the Hour is near.

ayahs.ar: يَسْتَعْجِلُ بِهَا الَّذِيْنَ لَا يُو͏ٔ͏ْمِنُوْنَ بِهَاۚ وَالَّذِيْنَ اٰمَنُوْا مُشْفِقُوْنَ مِنْهَاۙ وَيَعْلَمُوْنَ اَنَّهَا الْحَقُّؕ اَلَا͏ٓ اِنَّ الَّذِيْنَ يُمَارُوْنَ فِي السَّاعَةِ لَفِيْ ضَلٰلٍۭ بَعِيْدٍ ۝١٨
ayahs.tr: Those who do not believe in it are impatient for it, but those who believe are fearful of it and know that it is the truth. Unquestionably, those who dispute concerning the Hour are in extreme error.

ayahs.ar: اَللّٰهُ لَطِيْفٌۢ بِعِبَادِهٖ يَرْزُقُ مَنْ يَّشَا࢜ءُۚ وَهُوَ الْقَوِيُّ الْعَزِيْزُ ۝١٩ࣖ
ayahs.tr: Allah is Subtle with His servants; He gives provisions to whom He wills. And He is the Powerful, the Exalted in Might.

ayahs.ar: مَنْ كَانَ يُرِيْدُ حَرْثَ الْاٰخِرَةِ نَزِدْ لَهٗ فِيْ حَرْثِهٖۚ وَمَنْ كَانَ يُرِيْدُ حَرْثَ الدُّنْيَا نُو͏ٔ͏ْتِهٖ مِنْهَاۙ وَمَا لَهٗ فِي الْاٰخِرَةِ مِنْ نَّصِيْبٍ ۝٢٠
ayahs.tr: Whoever desires the harvest of the Hereafter - We increase for him in his harvest. And whoever desires the harvest of this world - We give him thereof, but there is not for him in the Hereafter any share.

ayahs.ar: اَمْ لَهُمْ شُرَكٰ࢜و͏ٔ͏ُا شَرَعُوْا لَهُمْ مِّنَ الدِّيْنِ مَا لَمْ يَاْذَنْۢ بِهِ اللّٰهُؕ وَلَوْلَا كَلِمَةُ الْفَصْلِ لَقُضِيَ بَيْنَهُمْؕ وَاِنَّ الظّٰلِمِيْنَ لَهُمْ عَذَابٌ اَلِيْمٌ ۝٢١
ayahs.tr: Or have they other deities who have ordained for them a religion to which Allah has not consented? But if not for the decisive word, it would have been concluded between them. And indeed, the wrongdoers will have a painful punishment.

ayahs.ar: تَرَي الظّٰلِمِيْنَ مُشْفِقِيْنَ مِمَّا كَسَبُوْا وَهُوَ وَاقِعٌۢ بِهِمْؕ وَالَّذِيْنَ اٰمَنُوْا وَعَمِلُوا الصّٰلِحٰتِ فِيْ رَوْضٰتِ الْجَنّٰتِۚ لَهُمْ مَّا يَشَا࢜ءُوْنَ عِنْدَ رَبِّهِمْؕ ذٰلِكَ هُوَ الْفَضْلُ الْكَبِيْرُ ۝٢٢
ayahs.tr: You will see the wrongdoers fearful of what they have earned, and it will [certainly] befall them. And those who have believed and done righteous deeds will be in lush regions of the gardens [in Paradise] having whatever they will in the presence of their Lord. That is what is the great bounty.

ayahs.ar: ذٰلِكَ الَّذِيْ يُبَشِّرُ اللّٰهُ عِبَادَهُ الَّذِيْنَ اٰمَنُوْا وَعَمِلُوا الصّٰلِحٰتِؕ قُلْ لَّا͏ٓ اَسْـَٔلُكُمْ عَلَيْهِ اَجْرًا اِلَّا الْمَوَدَّةَ فِي الْقُرْبٰيؕ وَمَنْ يَّقْتَرِفْ حَسَنَةً نَّزِدْ لَهٗ فِيْهَا حُسْنًاؕ اِنَّ اللّٰهَ غَفُوْرٌ شَكُوْرٌ ۝٢٣
ayahs.tr: It is that of which Allah gives good tidings to His servants who believe and do righteous deeds. Say, [O Muhammad], "I do not ask you for this message any payment [but] only good will through kinship." And whoever commits a good deed - We will increase for him good therein. Indeed, Allah is Forgiving and Appreciative.

ayahs.ar: اَمْ يَقُوْلُوْنَ افْتَرٰي عَلَي اللّٰهِ كَذِبًاۚ فَاِنْ يَّشَاِ اللّٰهُ يَخْتِمْ عَلٰي قَلْبِكَؕ وَيَمْحُ اللّٰهُ الْبَاطِلَ وَيُحِقُّ الْحَقَّ بِكَلِمٰتِهٖؕ اِنَّهٗ عَلِيْمٌۢ بِذَاتِ الصُّدُوْرِ ۝٢٤
ayahs.tr: Or do they say, "He has invented about Allah a lie"? But if Allah willed, He could seal over your heart. And Allah eliminates falsehood and establishes the truth by His words. Indeed, He is Knowing of that within the breasts.

ayahs.ar: وَهُوَ الَّذِيْ يَقْبَلُ التَّوْبَةَ عَنْ عِبَادِهٖ وَيَعْفُوْا عَنِ السَّيِّاٰتِ وَيَعْلَمُ مَا تَفْعَلُوْنَ ۝٢٥ۙ
ayahs.tr: And it is He who accepts repentance from his servants and pardons misdeeds, and He knows what you do.

ayahs.ar: وَيَسْتَجِيْبُ الَّذِيْنَ اٰمَنُوْا وَعَمِلُوا الصّٰلِحٰتِ وَيَزِيْدُهُمْ مِّنْ فَضْلِهٖؕ وَالْكٰفِرُوْنَ لَهُمْ عَذَابٌ شَدِيْدٌ ۝٢٦
ayahs.tr: And He answers [the supplication of] those who have believed and done righteous deeds and increases [for] them from His bounty. But the disbelievers will have a severe punishment.

ayahs.ar: وَلَوْ بَسَطَ اللّٰهُ الرِّزْقَ لِعِبَادِهٖ لَبَغَوْا فِي الْاَرْضِ وَلٰكِنْ يُّنَزِّلُ بِقَدَرٍ مَّا يَشَا࢜ءُؕ اِنَّهٗ بِعِبَادِهٖ خَبِيْرٌۢ بَصِيْرٌ ۝٢٧
ayahs.tr: And if Allah had extended [excessively] provision for His servants, they would have committed tyranny throughout the earth. But He sends [it] down in an amount which He wills. Indeed He is, of His servants, Acquainted and Seeing.

ayahs.ar: وَهُوَ الَّذِيْ يُنَزِّلُ الْغَيْثَ مِنْۢ بَعْدِ مَا قَنَطُوْا وَيَنْشُرُ رَحْمَتَهٗؕ وَهُوَ الْوَلِيُّ الْحَمِيْدُ ۝٢٨
ayahs.tr: And it is He who sends down the rain after they had despaired and spreads His mercy. And He is the Protector, the Praiseworthy.

ayahs.ar: وَمِنْ اٰيٰتِهٖ خَلْقُ السَّمٰوٰتِ وَالْاَرْضِ وَمَا بَثَّ فِيْهِمَا مِنْ دَا࢜بَّةٍؕ وَهُوَ عَلٰي جَمْعِهِمْ اِذَا يَشَا࢜ءُ قَدِيْرٌ ۝٢٩ࣖ
ayahs.tr: And of his signs is the creation of the heavens and earth and what He has dispersed throughout them of creatures. And He, for gathering them when He wills, is competent.

ayahs.ar: وَمَا͏ٓ اَصَابَكُمْ مِّنْ مُّصِيْبَةٍ فَبِمَا كَسَبَتْ اَيْدِيْكُمْ وَيَعْفُوْا عَنْ كَثِيْرٍ ۝٣٠ؕ
ayahs.tr: And whatever strikes you of disaster - it is for what your hands have earned; but He pardons much.

ayahs.ar: وَمَا͏ٓ اَنْتُمْ بِمُعْجِزِيْنَ فِي الْاَرْضِۚۖ وَمَا لَكُمْ مِّنْ دُوْنِ اللّٰهِ مِنْ وَّلِيٍّ وَّلَا نَصِيْرٍ ۝٣١
ayahs.tr: And you will not cause failure [to Allah] upon the earth. And you have not besides Allah any protector or helper.

ayahs.ar: وَمِنْ اٰيٰتِهِ الْجَوَارِ فِي الْبَحْرِ كَالْاَعْلَامِ ۝٣٢ؕ
ayahs.tr: And of His signs are the ships in the sea, like mountains.

ayahs.ar: اِنْ يَّشَاْ يُسْكِنِ الرِّيْحَ فَيَظْلَلْنَ رَوَاكِدَ عَلٰي ظَهْرِهٖؕ اِنَّ فِيْ ذٰلِكَ لَاٰيٰتٍ لِّكُلِّ صَبَّارٍ شَكُوْرٍ ۝٣٣ۙ
ayahs.tr: If He willed, He could still the wind, and they would remain motionless on its surface. Indeed in that are signs for everyone patient and grateful.

ayahs.ar: اَوْ يُوْبِقْهُنَّ بِمَا كَسَبُوْا وَيَعْفُ عَنْ كَثِيْرٍ ۝٣٤ؗ
ayahs.tr: Or He could destroy them for what they earned; but He pardons much.

ayahs.ar: وَّيَعْلَمَ الَّذِيْنَ يُجَادِلُوْنَ فِيْٓ اٰيٰتِنَاؕ مَا لَهُمْ مِّنْ مَّحِيْصٍ ۝٣٥
ayahs.tr: And [that is so] those who dispute concerning Our signs may know that for them there is no place of escape.

ayahs.ar: فَمَا͏ٓ اُوْتِيْتُمْ مِّنْ شَيْءٍ فَمَتَاعُ الْحَيٰوةِ الدُّنْيَاۚ وَمَا عِنْدَ اللّٰهِ خَيْرٌ وَّاَبْقٰي لِلَّذِيْنَ اٰمَنُوْا وَعَلٰي رَبِّهِمْ يَتَوَكَّلُوْنَ ۝٣٦ۚ
ayahs.tr: So whatever thing you have been given - it is but [for] enjoyment of the worldly life. But what is with Allah is better and more lasting for those who have believed and upon their Lord rely

ayahs.ar: وَالَّذِيْنَ يَجْتَنِبُوْنَ كَبٰ࢜ىِٕرَ الْاِثْمِ وَالْفَوَاحِشَ وَاِذَا مَا غَضِبُوْا هُمْ يَغْفِرُوْنَ ۝٣٧ۚ
ayahs.tr: And those who avoid the major sins and immoralities, and when they are angry, they forgive,

ayahs.ar: وَالَّذِيْنَ اسْتَجَابُوْا لِرَبِّهِمْ وَاَقَامُوا الصَّلٰوةَࣕ وَاَمْرُهُمْ شُوْرٰي بَيْنَهُمْࣕ وَمِمَّا رَزَقْنٰهُمْ يُنْفِقُوْنَ ۝٣٨ۚ
ayahs.tr: And those who have responded to their lord and established prayer and whose affair is [determined by] consultation among themselves, and from what We have provided them, they spend.

ayahs.ar: وَالَّذِيْنَ اِذَا͏ٓ اَصَابَهُمُ الْبَغْيُ هُمْ يَنْتَصِرُوْنَ ۝٣٩
ayahs.tr: And those who, when tyranny strikes them, they defend themselves,

ayahs.ar: وَجَزٰ࢜و͏ٔ͏ُا سَيِّي͏ٔ͏َةٍ سَيِّي͏ٔ͏َةٌ مِّثْلُهَاۚ فَمَنْ عَفَا وَاَصْلَحَ فَاَجْرُهٗ عَلَي اللّٰهِؕ اِنَّهٗ لَا يُحِبُّ الظّٰلِمِيْنَ ۝٤٠
ayahs.tr: And the retribution for an evil act is an evil one like it, but whoever pardons and makes reconciliation - his reward is [due] from Allah. Indeed, He does not like wrongdoers.

ayahs.ar: وَلَمَنِ انْتَصَرَ بَعْدَ ظُلْمِهٖ فَاُولٰ࢜ىِٕكَ مَا عَلَيْهِمْ مِّنْ سَبِيْلٍ ۝٤١ؕ
ayahs.tr: And whoever avenges himself after having been wronged - those have not upon them any cause [for blame].

ayahs.ar: اِنَّمَا السَّبِيْلُ عَلَي الَّذِيْنَ يَظْلِمُوْنَ النَّاسَ وَيَبْغُوْنَ فِي الْاَرْضِ بِغَيْرِ الْحَقِّؕ اُولٰ࢜ىِٕكَ لَهُمْ عَذَابٌ اَلِيْمٌ ۝٤٢
ayahs.tr: The cause is only against the ones who wrong the people and tyrannize upon the earth without right. Those will have a painful punishment.

ayahs.ar: وَلَمَنْ صَبَرَ وَغَفَرَ اِنَّ ذٰلِكَ لَمِنْ عَزْمِ الْاُمُوْرِ ۝٤٣ࣖ
ayahs.tr: And whoever is patient and forgives - indeed, that is of the matters [requiring] determination.

ayahs.ar: وَمَنْ يُّضْلِلِ اللّٰهُ فَمَا لَهٗ مِنْ وَّلِيٍّ مِّنْۢ بَعْدِهٖؕ وَتَرَي الظّٰلِمِيْنَ لَمَّا رَاَوُا الْعَذَابَ يَقُوْلُوْنَ هَلْ اِلٰي مَرَدٍّ مِّنْ سَبِيْلٍ ۝٤٤ۚ
ayahs.tr: And he whom Allah sends astray - for him there is no protector beyond Him. And you will see the wrongdoers, when they see the punishment, saying, "Is there for return [to the former world] any way?"

ayahs.ar: وَتَرٰىهُمْ يُعْرَضُوْنَ عَلَيْهَا خٰشِعِيْنَ مِنَ الذُّلِّ يَنْظُرُوْنَ مِنْ طَرْفٍ خَفِيٍّؕ وَقَالَ الَّذِيْنَ اٰمَنُوْٓا اِنَّ الْخٰسِرِيْنَ الَّذِيْنَ خَسِرُوْٓا اَنْفُسَهُمْ وَاَهْلِيْهِمْ يَوْمَ الْقِيٰمَةِؕ اَلَا͏ٓ اِنَّ الظّٰلِمِيْنَ فِيْ عَذَابٍ مُّقِيْمٍ ۝٤٥
ayahs.tr: And you will see them being exposed to the Fire, humbled from humiliation, looking from [behind] a covert glance. And those who had believed will say, "Indeed, the [true] losers are the ones who lost themselves and their families on the Day of Resurrection. Unquestionably, the wrongdoers are in an enduring punishment."

ayahs.ar: وَمَا كَانَ لَهُمْ مِّنْ اَوْلِيَا࢜ءَ يَنْصُرُوْنَهُمْ مِّنْ دُوْنِ اللّٰهِؕ وَمَنْ يُّضْلِلِ اللّٰهُ فَمَا لَهٗ مِنْ سَبِيْلٍ ۝٤٦ؕ
ayahs.tr: And there will not be for them any allies to aid them other than Allah. And whoever Allah sends astray - for him there is no way.

ayahs.ar: اِسْتَجِيْبُوْا لِرَبِّكُمْ مِّنْ قَبْلِ اَنْ يَّاْتِيَ يَوْمٌ لَّا مَرَدَّ لَهٗ مِنَ اللّٰهِؕ مَا لَكُمْ مِّنْ مَّلْجَاٍ يَّوْمَىِٕذٍ وَّمَا لَكُمْ مِّنْ نَّكِيْرٍ ۝٤٧
ayahs.tr: Respond to your Lord before a Day comes from Allah of which there is no repelling. No refuge will you have that day, nor for you will there be any denial.

ayahs.ar: فَاِنْ اَعْرَضُوْا فَمَا͏ٓ اَرْسَلْنٰكَ عَلَيْهِمْ حَفِيْظًاؕ اِنْ عَلَيْكَ اِلَّا الْبَلٰغُؕ وَاِنَّا͏ٓ اِذَا͏ٓ اَذَقْنَا الْاِنْسَانَ مِنَّا رَحْمَةً فَرِحَ بِهَاۚ وَاِنْ تُصِبْهُمْ سَيِّي͏ٔ͏َةٌۢ بِمَا قَدَّمَتْ اَيْدِيْهِمْ فَاِنَّ الْاِنْسَانَ كَفُوْرٌ ۝٤٨
ayahs.tr: But if they turn away - then We have not sent you, [O Muhammad], over them as a guardian; upon you is only [the duty of] notification. And indeed, when We let man taste mercy from us, he rejoices in it; but if evil afflicts him for what his hands have put forth, then indeed, man is ungrateful.

ayahs.ar: لِلّٰهِ مُلْكُ السَّمٰوٰتِ وَالْاَرْضِؕ يَخْلُقُ مَا يَشَا࢜ءُؕ يَهَبُ لِمَنْ يَّشَا࢜ءُ اِنَاثًا وَّيَهَبُ لِمَنْ يَّشَا࢜ءُ الذُّكُوْرَ ۝٤٩ۙ
ayahs.tr: To Allah belongs the dominion of the heavens and the earth; He creates what he wills. He gives to whom He wills female [children], and He gives to whom He wills males.

ayahs.ar: اَوْ يُزَوِّجُهُمْ ذُكْرَانًا وَّاِنَاثًاۚ وَيَجْعَلُ مَنْ يَّشَا࢜ءُ عَقِيْمًاؕ اِنَّهٗ عَلِيْمٌ قَدِيْرٌ ۝٥٠
ayahs.tr: Or He makes them [both] males and females, and He renders whom He wills barren. Indeed, He is Knowing and Competent.

ayahs.ar: وَمَا كَانَ لِبَشَرٍ اَنْ يُّكَلِّمَهُ اللّٰهُ اِلَّا وَحْيًا اَوْ مِنْ وَّرَا࢜ي͏ٔ͏ِ حِجَابٍ اَوْ يُرْسِلَ رَسُوْلًا فَيُوْحِيَ بِاِذْنِهٖ مَا يَشَا࢜ءُؕ اِنَّهٗ عَلِيٌّ حَكِيْمٌ ۝٥١
ayahs.tr: And it is not for any human being that Allah should speak to him except by revelation or from behind a partition or that He sends a messenger to reveal, by His permission, what He wills. Indeed, He is Most High and Wise.

ayahs.ar: وَكَذٰلِكَ اَوْحَيْنَا͏ٓ اِلَيْكَ رُوْحًا مِّنْ اَمْرِنَاؕ مَا كُنْتَ تَدْرِيْ مَا الْكِتٰبُ وَلَا الْاِيْمَانُ وَلٰكِنْ جَعَلْنٰهُ نُوْرًا نَّهْدِيْ بِهٖ مَنْ نَّشَا࢜ءُ مِنْ عِبَادِنَاؕ وَاِنَّكَ لَتَهْدِيْٓ اِلٰي صِرَاطٍ مُّسْتَقِيْمٍ ۝٥٢ۙ
ayahs.tr: And thus We have revealed to you an inspiration of Our command. You did not know what is the Book or [what is] faith, but We have made it a light by which We guide whom We will of Our servants. And indeed, [O Muhammad], you guide to a straight path -

ayahs.ar: صِرَاطِ اللّٰهِ الَّذِيْ لَهٗ مَا فِي السَّمٰوٰتِ وَمَا فِي الْاَرْضِؕ اَلَا͏ٓ اِلَي اللّٰهِ تَصِيْرُ الْاُمُوْرُ ۝٥٣ࣖ
ayahs.tr: The path of Allah, to whom belongs whatever is in the heavens and whatever is on the earth. Unquestionably, to Allah do [all] matters evolve.
